description: This file defines the interface and implementation of a wrapper around GLib functions, including classes for a factory and the wrapper itself, with methods for GObject property management, signal handling, and type information. It is part of the Rialto media server component.

classes.name: GlibWrapperFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and managing singleton instances of GlibWrapper.

classes.name: GlibWrapper
classes.description: Implementation of IGlibWrapper interface, providing wrappers around GLib functions.

methods.name: getGlibWrapper
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to an IGlibWrapper instance, implementing singleton pattern.

methods.name: gObjectSet
methods.description: Sets properties on a GObject instance.

methods.name: gObjectGet
methods.description: Gets properties from a GObject instance.

methods.name: gObjectClassFindProperty
methods.description: Finds a property in a GObject class.

methods.name: gTypeClassRef
methods.description: References a GType class.

methods.name: gTypeFromName
methods.description: Gets a GType from a name.

methods.name: gFlagsGetValueByNick
methods.description: Retrieves a GFlagsValue by its nickname.

methods.name: gObjectUnref
methods.description: Unreferences a GObject.

methods.name: gSignalConnect
methods.description: Connects a signal handler to a GObject instance.

methods.name: gSignalHandlerDisconnect
methods.description: Disconnects a signal handler from a GObject.

methods.name: gTimeoutAdd
methods.description: Adds a timeout source.

methods.name: gSourceRemove
methods.description: Removes a source identified by its ID.

methods.name: gStrdupPrintf
methods.description: Duplicates a formatted string.

methods.name: gStrHasPrefix
methods.description: Checks if a string has a specific prefix.

methods.name: gFree
methods.description: Frees memory allocated by GLib.

methods.name: gSignalListIds
methods.description: Lists signal IDs for a given type.

methods.name: gSignalQuery
methods.description: Queries information about a signal.

methods.name: gTypeParent
methods.description: Gets the parent type of a GType.

methods.name: gObjectType
methods.description: Gets the GType of a GObject.

methods.name: gMalloc
methods.description: Allocates memory.

methods.name: gMemdup
methods.description: Duplicates memory block.

methods.name: gMemdup2
methods.description: Duplicates memory block (version 2).

methods.name: gOnceInitEnter
methods.description: Enters one-time initialization.

methods.name: gOnceInitLeave
methods.description: Leaves one-time initialization.

methods.name: gStrrstr
methods.description: Finds the last occurrence of a substring.

methods.name: gErrorFree
methods.description: Frees a GError.
